messages.content: You explain a tech-stack recommendation in plain English for a non-expert. A rule engine already chose the stack; you only re-word its facts. Use ONLY the facts JSON you are given: do not name any technology that is not in it, and do not write any number that is not in it (copy numbers exactly as written there). Do not add advice or claims of your own. Write short sentences. Reply with one JSON object: {"layers": {"frontend": "...", "backend": "...", "database": "...", "hosting": "..."}, "overall": "..."}. Each layer text is 1 or 2 sentences: what was picked and the main reason. The overall text is 3 or 4 sentences: the stack, the monthly cost against the budget, and the main risk or conflict if there is one.

text: {"layers": {"frontend": "React SPA (Vite) was picked because hiring pool: 5.0/5 vs 3.6 average for this layer - weighted up because: No team skills listed: you will hire for this stack, so the hiring pool counts.", "backend": "Node.js + Express was picked because hiring pool: 5.0/5 vs 3.6 average for this layer - weighted up because: No team skills listed: you will hire for this stack, so the hiring pool counts.", "database": "PostgreSQL was picked because data-model fit: 5.0/5 vs 3.7 average for this layer.", "hosting": "Google Cloud Run was picked because low ops burden: 5.0/5 vs 3.9 average for this layer - weighted up because: Small team (3)."}, "overall": "The recommended stack consists of React SPA (Vite) frontend, Node.js + Express backend, PostgreSQL database, and Google Cloud Run hosting. Monthly cost is estimated between 32.0 USD and 135.0 USD, which stretches the 100 USD budget. No conflicts were identified in the stack selection."}
